intent: Bundle mount-s3 and blobfuse2 into appliance image via appliance-build Ansible role (HM-5952)

jira_context.summary: Bundle mount-s3 and blobfuse2 into appliance image via appliance-build Ansible role
jira_context.description: <untrusted_content source="jira:HM-5952">The Snowflake connector requires FUSE-based filesystem drivers (mount-s3 and blobfuse2) to mount S3 and Azure Blob staging areas at /mnt/hyperscale on the closed appliance host. These packages must be bundled as part of the appliance image build via the appliance-build.hyperscale-common Ansible role, before the delphix-hyperscale package is installed. Affected file: live-build/misc/ansible-roles/appliance-build.hyperscale-common/tasks/main.yml. Constraints: must not break existing pipeline, blobfuse2 x86-only, use blobfuse2 v2 not legacy blobfuse, OSRB approval needed (DLPXECO-13872). Acceptance criteria: mount-s3 binary present, blobfuse2 binary present, fuse3 and libfuse2t64 present, appliance-build-stage0 Jenkins job passes, no MongoDB connector regression.</untrusted_content>
jira_context.acceptance_criteria: mount-s3 and blobfuse2 binaries present, fuse3 and libfuse2t64 present, appliance-build-stage0 passes, no MongoDB regression
